findings.evidence:
TiDB: `pkg/executor/mem_reader.go:584-622` creates `txn.GetMemBuffer().SnapshotIter*` iterators (and sometimes `transaction.NewUnionIter`) but never calls `iter.Close()` on normal exit or early-return error paths; `pkg/executor/mem_reader.go:343-375` assigns `iter.curr = tmp` for each kv-range without closing the previous iterator when advancing ranges, so only the *last* iterator can be closed via `pkg/executor/mem_reader.go:399-403`.
client-go (bumped by this PR): ART snapshot iterators increment a global snapshot block counter on creation (`github.com/tikv/client-go/v2@v2.0.8-0.20241120024459-05d115b3e88b/internal/unionstore/art/art_snapshot.go:56`) and decrement it only in `SnapIter.Close()` (`.../art_snapshot.go:117-122`); node reuse/freeing is gated on this counter (`.../art_arena.go:189-210`). Not closing iterators leaks the counter and prevents reclaim/reuse of old-version nodes.
findings.fix:
Ensure every snapshot iterator is deterministically closed:
- In `iterTxnMemBuffer`, call `iter.Close()` once finished with each range (use an inner func or `defer` to guarantee Close on all error paths).
- In `(*txnMemBufferIter).Valid`, close the previous `iter.curr` before advancing `idx` / overwriting `iter.curr`.
- Also close any just-created iterator(s) when `getSnapIter` / `transaction.NewUnionIter` fails to avoid leaking on constructor errors.
findings.impact: High risk of MemDB old-version/node reuse being permanently blocked (snapshot refcount leak), leading to growing memory usage and possible OOM/statement failures under retries or in union-scan paths that touch many key ranges (e.g., index lookup/join, index merge, partitioned keep-order reads).
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed as of `upstream/master` (3b531d4e3d): `pkg/executor/mem_reader.go` still lacks `iter.Close()` in `iterTxnMemBuffer` and still overwrites `txnMemBufferIter.curr` without closing prior iterators; upstream client-go (`v2.0.8-0.20260316081220-602cdf086c43`) still uses `snapshotInc/snapshotDec` in `internal/unionstore/art/art_snapshot.go`.
findings.verify:
Run targeted tests and add coverage for multi-range snapshots:
- `go test ./pkg/executor -run TestSnapshotWithConcurrentWrite`
- `go test ./pkg/session/test/txn -run TestMemBufferCleanupMemoryLeak`
- Add a regression that forces many `kvRanges` (e.g., large IN-list / index-join point ranges inside a txn) and asserts no OOM under a small `tidb_mem_quota_query` across repeated statement failures/retries.
findings.what: Snapshot iterators from ART MemDB are not consistently closed in executor mem-buffer scans (`iterTxnMemBuffer` and per-range iteration in `txnMemBufferIter`), which can leak client-go snapshot bookkeeping and prevent freeing/reuse of old-version nodes, causing memory growth/OOM after bumping `client-go`.
